title: holdout-verdict contract data
description: Reference schema (FAFF-34). The SHAPE of the code-blind holdout verdict the `evaluator` slot's producer (default faffter-noon-evaluate) emits after exercising a built feature against its spec in a provisioned env. Shape is normative here; the verdict SEMANTICS (the aggregate derivation, the prose->needs-human rule) live in the gateway / ADR-0032. Fail-loud on a non-object input (no safe coerce target — faff's own producer emits it). `aggregate`, each criterion's `class`, and each `verdict` are plain strings here: their enums ({meets-spec,gaps,fails,needs-human} / {scenario,assertion,prose} / {met,unmet,needs-human}) are enforced in the compute fn via violations (the env-handle/architecture-proposal precedent), so an echoed bad value is exit 1, never a spurious schemaCheck fail-loud (exit 2). The compute fn also enforces the cross-field rules that make exit 0: code_blind MUST be true; a prose criterion MUST be needs-human; a met/unmet criterion MUST carry evidence; and the aggregate MUST match the derivation from the criteria — fail-safe coercion is toward needs-human, never meets-spec.
